company_name: HIDICON SEMICONDUCTOR DEVICES TECHNOLOGY Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Hidicon Semiconductor Devices Technology specializes in high precision control systems and equipment used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Hidicon Semiconductor Devices Technology Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and services high precision control systems for various semiconductor equipment, including diffusion furnaces and CVD systems. Their products are recognized for precision and reliability, catering to the needs of major microelectronics companies in China.

regional_presence.China: Hidicon's products are widely used by several major microelectronics companies in China.
